@graph.headline: Sprint Retrospective Template for 2026: 40 Questions
@graph.description: Sprint retrospective samples for 2026: a copy-ready template, 5 formats, 40 questions and sample answers for what went well, plus how to turn actions into Jira.

acceptedAnswer.text: A sprint retrospective is a Scrum event at the end of each sprint where the team reviews how it worked and agrees on improvements for the next sprint.

mainEntity.name: How long should a sprint retrospective be?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Scrum Guide timeboxes it to a maximum of 3 hours for a 1-month sprint. Most 2-week sprints use 45 to 90 minutes.

mainEntity.name: What are the 3 questions of a sprint retrospective?

acceptedAnswer.text: The classic 3 questions are: What went well? What did not go well? What will we do differently next sprint?

mainEntity.name: How often should sprint retrospectives happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once per sprint, at the end, after the sprint review and before the next sprint planning.
The Scrum team: developers, the product owner and the Scrum Master. Stakeholders usually attend the sprint review instead.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a sprint review and a retrospective?

acceptedAnswer.text: The sprint review inspects the product increment with stakeholders.
